name: How does AKN Design Group integrate structural changes into a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group integrate structural changes into a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group approaches structural changes within a whole-home remodel as an integral part of the overall design-build plan. We begin by evaluating the existing structure and discussing your vision for improved flow and functionality. Our design team, in collaboration with structural engineers, then develops precise plans for any wall removals, additions, or reconfigurations. We manage the entire process, from initial design and permit coordination to the careful execution of construction and seamless integration of new and existing elements. This managed process ensures a cohesive outcome that enhances functionality, beauty, and value, avoiding piecemeal solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group integrates structural changes into whole-home remodels through a unified design-build process, from initial evaluation and engineering plans to construction and seamless integration, for a cohesive outcome.
